details: MISSION: LOST SIGNAL is an interactive educational project focused on forgotten and abandoned spacecraft - missions that have concluded their operations but left behind a significant scientific and historical legacy. Our goal is to make information about these missions more accessible and engaging for the younger generation. To achieve this, we have created a physical model of outer space featuring replicas of these spacecraft, complemented by visual materials and straightforward explanations. The project encourages children to explore the history of space exploration, fosters curiosity, and makes the study of complex scientific topics more compelling. Its key feature is the integration of physical interaction with educational content, moving beyond the typical website or app format. In developing the project, we prioritized accessibility, ease of understanding, the interests of our target audience, and the feasibility of implementation on a minimal budget. The model was constructed using cardboard, paper, foil, and other readily available materials, while our research into the missions relied on publicly accessible NASA resources. We aim to demonstrate that the conclusion of a space mission does not mark the end of its story- and that its achievements deserve to be remembered.
